presets.label: raid (daggers)
why: Dagger build to Mutilate: Malice, Lethality, Cold Blood and Seal Fate (3/3) turn critical strikes into extra combo points, and Puncturing Wounds and Opportunity add Backstab and Mutilate crit and damage.
Vile Poisons and Improved Poisons strengthen your poisons, Venom makes Shank raise poison damage and application chance for 6 sec, and Relentless Strikes (5/5) refunds Energy from finishers.
Murder and Improved Eviscerate are gone. Their points now go to Coup de Grace for Eviscerate damage, with Precision for 3% hit.

presets.label: leveling to 30 (reaches Venom)
why: Malice and Remorseless Attacks add crit, Lethality adds critical damage, and Ruthlessness can add a combo point after a finisher.
Improved Poisons and Venom on row 5 work with Shank, which Rogues learn at level 24, for more poison damage. Vigor and Blood Splatter fill the rows in between.
Mutilate now sits on row 7 and needs 30 points, so this build cannot reach it before level 40. The old “reaches Mutilate” goal no longer fits a level-30 build.

presets.label: raid (swords or axes)
why: Swords or axes with Hack and Slash for extra attacks, Blade Flurry into Adrenaline Rush, and Weapon Expertise so fewer attacks are dodged or parried.

Coup de Grace, Efficient Strikes, Aggression and Flawless Execution make Sinister Strike and Eviscerate cheaper or stronger. Dual Wield Specialization (2/2) adds 50% off-hand damage, and Flash of Steel makes Shank generate more Energy.

Sixteen Assassination points take Malice, Ruthlessness, Improved Slice and Dice, Vigor, Lethality and Cold Blood. Improved Eviscerate became Coup de Grace and Improved Sinister Strike became Efficient Strikes; Murder was removed.

presets.label: leveling to 30
why: Coup de Grace, Efficient Strikes, Aggression and Flawless Execution make Sinister Strike and Eviscerate cheaper or stronger while you level.
Deflection opens Riposte, which disarms the target after you parry. Endurance shortens Sprint and Evasion, and Improved Sprint can break movement effects.
Blade Flurry at 21 points hits a second target. Dual Wield Specialization, now two ranks on row 5, is the next pick after level 30.

presets.label: raid (bleed style)
why: Bleed build to Death Mark: Serrated Blades and Hemorrhage raise Rupture and Garrote damage, and Death Mark stores Garrote and Rupture damage at twice the rate for 6 sec.
Coup de Grace raises Death Mark’s damage and storage rate, Efficient Strikes discounts Hemorrhage, Blood Splatter lengthens Rupture and Garrote, and Boot Knife lets Shank add combo points.
Quietus, Thousand Cuts, Murder and Improved Eviscerate were removed. Their points now go to Opportunity, Boot Knife, Death Mark and Coup de Grace.

presets.label: battlegrounds
why: Stealth openers: Master of Deception, Camouflage, Dirty Deeds, Improved Ambush, Initiative and Premeditation, with Preparation to reset your cooldowns.

Ghostly Strike lets your next Ambush or Garrote within 7 sec skip Stealth, Elusiveness shortens Vanish and Blind, and Dirty Tricks and Quick Getaway make Sap and Blind cheaper and let you keep a second target Sapped.
Twenty Combat points take Lightning Reflexes, Deflection and Riposte, Improved Kick, Endurance and Improved Sprint. Cutthroat was removed; its points went to Camouflage and Quick Getaway.
